name: v2_inverse_aging
description: Inverse problem on one aged-cell 1C discharge (step C, commercial-cell data): estimate the aging parameters theta_n0, theta_p0 (loss of lithium inventory, as multipliers of the fresh initial stoichiometries), eps_am_n, eps_am_p (loss of active material, multipliers of the active-material volume fractions) and R0 (lumped series resistance, Ohm) from the CC part of the discharge voltage, t >= 100 s. Protocol and data file are set per cycle by scripts/v2_inverse_aging.py; warm start from a fresh forward model with --init (architecture must match).
